description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the project from Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.7.18 to Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.x
tasks.reason: The assessment identified that Java 8 (azure-java-version-02000) and Spring Boot 2.7.18 (spring-boot-to-azure-spring-boot-version-01000) are end-of-life and must be upgraded. Spring Framework 5.x is also EOL (spring-framework-version-01000). Company targets require Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.0+.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project to Spring Boot 4.x (latest stable) targeting Java 25. This includes upgrading Spring Framework to 7.x and migrating all javax.* imports to jakarta.* (Jakarta EE migration). Update pom.xml to reflect the new versions. Ensure all existing functionality continues to work after the upgrade.

tasks.description: Migrate messaging from RabbitMQ Spring AMQP to Azure Service Bus
tasks.reason: The assessment found Spring AMQP RabbitMQ usage in both code (azure-message-queue-rabbitmq-01000) and dependencies (azure-message-queue-amqp-02000). To run on Azure the messaging must be migrated to Azure Service Bus with Managed Identity authentication, replacing the on-premises RabbitMQ broker.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the three RabbitMQ AMQP queues (order-created, inventory-alert, approval-pending) and their message listeners to Azure Service Bus. Use Managed Identity for authentication. Replace Spring AMQP RabbitMQ dependencies with Spring Cloud Azure Service Bus dependencies. Update all connection configuration and remove RabbitMQ-specific connection settings from application.yml.

tasks.description: Move hardcoded credentials from application.yml to Azure Key Vault
tasks.reason: The assessment found hardcoded RabbitMQ credentials (username/password) in application.yml (azure-password-01000). Company policy prohibits hardcoded credentials and requires all sensitive values to be stored in Azure Key Vault.
tasks.requirements: Identify all hardcoded credentials in configuration files (application.yml) and source code. Migrate them to Azure Key Vault. Use Spring Cloud Azure Key Vault starter or Managed Identity to access secrets at runtime. Ensure no plaintext credentials remain in any configuration file, environment variables, or source code.

tasks.description: Replace SLF4J and System.out.println logging with InternalLogger
tasks.reason: Company policy (policies.md) prohibits SLF4J (@Slf4j, LoggerFactory) and System.out.println as they do not integrate with trace context. All logging must use InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger) which provides automatic trace ID injection, team tags, and structured JSON output.
tasks.requirements: Replace all SLF4J usages (@Slf4j annotation, LoggerFactory.getLogger(), log.info/warn/error calls) with InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger). Replace all System.out.println and System.err.println calls with InternalLogger equivalents. This applies to all Java source files in the project.

tasks.description: Identify and fix all CVE vulnerabilities in project dependencies
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested that all CVE issues be fixed as part of the Azure migration. Dependencies may contain known security vulnerabilities that must be remediated before deployment.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies (direct and transitive) for known CVE vulnerabilities. Upgrade any dependencies with known CVEs to patched versions. Verify the project builds and tests pass after dependency updates. The application must pass dependency vulnerability scanning with no critical or high severity CVEs remaining.

tasks.description: Containerize the application with a multi-stage Dockerfile
tasks.reason: The application must be containerized to deploy on Azure Container Apps. Company targets specify approved base images for Java 25 applications.
tasks.requirements: Create a multi-stage Dockerfile using the approved base images: mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu for the build stage and mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-distroless for the runtime stage. The Dockerfile should build the Maven project and produce a minimal production image.

tasks.description: Deploy the containerized application to Azure Container Apps
tasks.reason: Per company strategy (charter.md), all Java services in the supply chain system must be replatformed to Azure Container Apps (ACA). This is the final step to bring the application to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Deploy the containerized supplychain-worker to Azure Container Apps. Configure the container app with appropriate environment settings, Managed Identity for service-to-service authentication, and connections to Azure Service Bus and Azure Key Vault.
